newsitem.title: USA: Varlen buys German railcar equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Varlen buys German railcar equipment maker.

text.p: Varlen Corp said Wednesday it acquired German railcar cushioning device manufacturer Karl Georg for undisclosed terms.
It said the transaction is not expected to be dilutive to Varlen's earnings.
Karl Georg has two plants in Germany with annual revenues totaling $15 million. Terms call for current Karl Georg management will continue to run the company.
This is Varlen's second international acquisition related to railcar cushioning devices. It manufactures railcar buffers and other rail parts in France.
Varlen manufactures precision engineered transportation products for the railroad, heavy-duty truck/trailer and automotive industries.
